version_evidence: No trusted target Dify version or native export evidence was found in the authorized local repository and configuration search.

novice_experience_and_multi_candidate.scope: r2 lightweight reduction regression and original novice journey responsibilities

lightweight_architecture_and_trust_bound.scope: generic workflow engine removal, trust boundaries, and necessary regression

acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A01: Verify exactly one version-neutral conversation candidate and one natural-chat entry.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A02: Verify ordinary chat cannot create a plan, request preparation or authoring, or write brand facts.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A03: Verify inspiration, vague, clear, and return-to-chat journeys remain available and ask no more than three questions.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A04: Verify confirmation and server-confirmed scope are both required before the preparation placeholder, and edits require reconfirmation.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A05: Verify Dify values, self-reports, and conversation variables cannot grant identity, scope, or permission.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A06: Verify public models, internal product mapping, atomic components, relationships, and paths are not copied or re-owned.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A07: Verify two-to-three candidates, selected-reference binding, local revision, return, and human-only difference judgment.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A08: Verify missing facts, materials, authorization, scope, degradation, and blocking produce honest action cards without fake body text.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A09: Verify recursive user-visible output does not expose internal identifiers, fields, errors, secrets, or service URLs.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A10: Verify only selected reference, necessary modification, and short reason are retained as feedback.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A11: Re-run the unique checker, selftest, and fixed direct journey assertions.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-A12: Verify no real external calls, all readiness false, allowed write scope only, and 300/120/86 unharmed.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S01: Verify no reusable route language, graph traversal, guard/effect evaluator, or transition interpreter remains.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S02: Verify the checker directly asserts fixed parameterized journeys without interpreting a state graph.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S03: Verify PKG4-A01 through PKG4-A12 did not regress after subtraction.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S04: Verify identity, facts, authorization, scope, privacy, and leakage boundaries were not weakened.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S05: Verify ordinary expression, creative entry, and candidates do not depend on internal products or expression assets.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S06: Verify one candidate, one checker, and one representative journey set.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S07: Verify the revised candidate is not self-approved before targeted rereviews and successful remote checks.
acceptance_review_request.PKG4-S08: Verify 300/120/86 remain unchanged or unharmed and external calls remain zero.
